location.provenance: Be it enacted by the Legislature of Louisiana:

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemicals" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom, including perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, and designed to be fully functional in Class B fire fighting foam formulations.

type.provenance: B.  On and after January 1, 2022, no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals unless discharged under either of the following conditions:

who.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

action.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

products.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals

value: fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation

training or testing purposes which occurs at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases of such Class B fire fighting foam into the environment
exceptions.provenance: unless discharged under either of the following conditions: (1) Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation. (2) Such discharge or other use is for training or testing purposes which occurs at a facility that has implemented containment, treatment, and disposal measures to prevent uncontrolled releases of such Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.
